Repository ↗ ← Back to work

PROBLEM

What needed to be solved

Kubernetes environments become difficult to operate when infrastructure, application delivery and observability evolve independently.

APPROACH

How I approached it

Built a platform-oriented EKS environment where infrastructure is reproducible and application delivery follows GitOps.

ARCHITECTURE

System design

  • AWS VPC and Amazon EKS
  • Terraform-managed infrastructure
  • Amazon ECR for container images
  • AWS Load Balancer Controller
  • Argo CD continuous delivery
  • Helm-based workloads
  • Prometheus, Grafana and Alertmanager

SECURITY & GUARDRAILS

Blast radius as configuration

  • IAM and IRSA patterns
  • Kubernetes RBAC
  • Private cluster-oriented design
  • Controlled workload permissions

OBSERVABILITY

Making failure visible

  • Prometheus metrics
  • Grafana dashboards
  • Alertmanager alerts
  • CloudWatch integration

OUTCOMES

What this demonstrates

  • Repeatable infrastructure
  • Git-based delivery
  • Centralized observability
  • Clear separation between infrastructure and workloads
